target_customer: CPA and accounting firms, plus fintechs and developers building on tax calculation
problem: Tax software for accounting firms is dated and fragmented. Luca IQ offers a deterministic tax calculation engine, workflow platform and IRS authorized e-filing, also via API.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage based API sold through CPA and tax firms

founders.name: Angelo Policicchio
founders.background_notes: A CPA; equity research associate at Credit Suisse, forensic accountant at the FBI, public accountant at EY per YC page.

founders.name: Akash Sadashivapeth
founders.background_notes: Head of Data Science at Welligence; launch post says employee 1 at a fintech data infrastructure startup.

competitors.name: April
competitors.what: Embeddable white label e-file provider with national coverage
competitors.traction_then: Reported first new nationally licensed e-file provider in over 15 years (2025)

competitors.name: Instead
competitors.what: New tax platform for professionals, says it completed government testing across all US jurisdictions

competitors.name: Column Tax
competitors.what: Embedded tax filing infrastructure for platforms
competitors.traction_then: Listed in an embedded tax provider directory in 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Deterministic tax rules plus passing IRS Modernized e-File assurance testing demanded regulatory and engineering rigor; approval covers only Form 1040 initially.

defensibility.rationale: IRS e-file authorization is a gate that few new entrants clear, but approval is narrow and other new entrants like April and Instead also hold approvals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not assessed from sources opened; incumbents dominate CPA tax software, and well funded new entrants already existed.

market_need_then: CPA firms depend on legacy tax software, and AI tools raised demand for API based tax engines; the company says it keeps a waiting list of firms.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional: the modern tax engine and workflow platform for CPA firms

branding.community_and_virality: Trade press coverage of launch by Accounting Today and others in July and August 2026

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press launch coverage but the name is shared with several other Luca companies; no brand specific evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Luca IQ is a Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. Its early win is IRS e-file approval for Form 1040 announced August 2026, which supports a regulatory position. Open questions are funding, scale through a first filing season and competition from April, Instead and incumbents.
notes: Funding: Dealroom lists a 125k USD seed with hidden investors, unverified; no press release found. One review says the company is based in Boston while YC lists San Francisco. IRS approval date of 2026-08-03 comes from YC page and trade outlets. Takeover risk rating is a judgment, incumbent actions not sourced. Completeness pass: the 125K seed is recorded from Dealroom alone (date and investors not shown). Single database, no press confirmation found in two searches.
